usedFor: ThriveCart holds checkouts and subscriptions, and TestMonitor opens an issue through “Create issue” after “Subscription Rebill Cancelled”.

bestTemplate.name: “Subscription Rebill Cancelled” in ThriveCart, then “Create issue” in TestMonitor
bestTemplate.why: A cancelled rebill becomes an issue with title, priority and assignee for someone to investigate.

watchOut: “Update issue” needs an existing issue, so use “Create issue” first for “Add On Purchased”.
